_about: What the Chaos Divers addon needs from game.dll, as offsets in game build 25480438, for tools/make_sigs.py (run on gamedump/game-25480438.mem). faction_manager: the unit list with each unit's side. mission_state: the object whose +0x2FC84 is the SEAF kill count and +0x2FC80 the value before it. traitor_tally: the object whose +0x450 holds 16 four-byte tallies of friendly kills (six = traitor), ids at +0x410, timer at +0x494. detector: the DetectorComponent manager (lookup table at +0x30, records of 0x13F8 bytes at +0x50); each record's +0x13E8 is that unit's own copy of its side, which is what it judges targets against. ui_font, ui_atlas, ui_material (optional, from the Passive Picker project): the game's own font, its atlas and the holder of its font material, for the on-screen banner (0.8). network (0.9, optional): the network context, for the host-only key.

targets.name: ui_atlas
targets._note: the game's code points at the atlas from one place only, so this one cannot move; it gets its own window on that place

targets.name: network
targets._note: 0.9: the game's network context (Better Lobby Management's CONTEXT_PTR, build 25480438): this player's peer id at +0xB398, the host's at +0xB3A8; equal = this game hosts
